title: iaera loheri
intro: Iaera loheri, commonly known as the "Australian Finger Lime," is a species of flowering plant native to Australia, belonging to the Rutaceae family. The Australian Finger Lime is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties that can aid in reducing inflammation and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of the Australian Finger Lime include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce stress, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the Australian Finger Lime include limonoids, flavonoids, and aromatic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal and culinary uses.
